task.text:
One final requirement: whenever an article is placed, its category must also be displayed. Use the Flat Plan and the site to determine the appropriate category.

The article categories are:

1\. Editorial / Cover Story
2\. Letter from the Editor
3\. America First
4\. Business
5\. Culture
6\. Faith
7\. People
8\. Politics
9\. Voices
10\. World

\*Please add a visually suitable category label alongside the title, followed by the author’s name and photo.

Thanks!
